race.comment: LONDON'S IMAGE (3) has trialled well coming into this after just missing as favourite in the Sheila Gwynne before the break. Drawn out, but she has the speed to work across from a tricky barrier and with CJP booked, she can return with a bang. HOT AND HIGH (6) was dynamic over the sprint trips before stretching to the mile and scoring the Belmont Guineas as the race favourite. An inside draw and a recent trial win are both big ticks. She'll be up front from the outset and with her upside, she appears the main danger. PLAYIN'IT SWEET (5) went back-to-back before the spell, pulling up lame after narrowly scoring in the Challenge Stakes. Fitter for a recent trial and things look to pan out nicely for her on resumption. CESSATION (4) has the race fitness on her side after a good resuming effort in the Golden Saddle. Not out of this. ESSENTRIC NATURE (2) has a strong fresh record and can put his best foot forward.
